summary: The PR addresses the issue by modifying the multiplication behavior of Dagger and Operator classes. It passes all tests but introduces some style inconsistencies.

issues.description: The removal of the future import statements is unnecessary and inconsistent with the rest of the file.
The addition of `Dagger` to the `isinstance` check in `operator.py` could be considered a minor style issue, as it might be clearer to handle this in the `Dagger` class itself.
